name: nanODE
status: Builds clean and passes its host tests. It has never run on a board, because no nanODE has been built yet.
connect: Wire a 3.3 V USB-serial adapter to the ESP32's castellations: adapter TX to U1 pin 34 (U0RXD), adapter RX to U1 pin 35 (U0TXD), and GND to any GND pad.
Put the board in download mode, then connect and pick the adapter's port.
notes: The board has no USB socket or header yet, so the first flash goes through the castellations. After that, updates go over the network. An adapter with the usual DTR/RTS auto-reset circuit, wired to EN (R30 pad 1) and IO0 (R31 pad 1), saves holding anything.
bootMode: Hold IO0 to GND at R31 pad 1 (or U1 pin 25).
Pulse EN to GND at R30 pad 1, or power-cycle the board.
keeps: its settings: the port patch and its network setup
